youtube_metadata.description:
Stanford and NVIDIA researchers unveiled CLM-8B, an architecture running autonomous agents up to 9x faster. Instead of slowly generating code token by token, it scores actions in vector space using contrastive learning. Hitting 87.6% on terminal benchmarks. Not a chatbot—an action engine.
